page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i1-c5d1.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. This instance features 16 dedicated physical cores with 16 vCPUs, operating with a single thread per core configuration. It is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

A key hardware characteristic of the ecs.i1-c5d1.4xlarge is its integrated local storage, which consists of 3126 GB of SSD capacity. This bundled local storage is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps. The instance runs on the KVM hypervisor and does not include any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a cost efficiency perspective, the inclusion of a large 3126 GB local SSD alongside dedicated CPU resources provides high local storage density relative to the compute allocation. However, the older Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor architecture and the 3 Gbps network baseline represent tradeoffs compared to newer generation instances. This hardware profile is structured for workloads requiring significant local storage capacity and dedicated CPU execution, such as database hosting, local data processing, and general-purpose applications with high disk I/O requirements.
